whatsNew.title: What's new in {{version}}
whatsNew.subtitle: Everything that changed in this update.

layout.title: A new, clearer layout
layout.desc: The menu button is gone: every tool now sits in a fixed sidebar, grouped into Download, Create and Edit & Analyze. Collapse it to icons with one click; on narrow windows it collapses by itself. Every page has the same title row with its actions on the right.

themes.title: Colour themes that change the whole app
themes.desc: Pick one of 9 themes (Ocean, Lagoon, Forest, Amber, Ember, Crimson, Orchid, Violet, Graphite) or any colour on the colour picker. The theme now tints backgrounds, the sidebar, borders, the active page and selections. Background tone (Neutral, Subtle, Rich) sets how strong it is; light mode uses deeper shades so text stays readable.

accessibility.title: New Accessibility settings
accessibility.desc: Text size (Small to Extra large) enlarges all text without breaking the layout, Display size zooms the whole interface from 90% to 150%, and Reduce motion turns animations off.

settings.title: Redesigned Settings
settings.desc: New order: Language, Appearance, Accessibility, Folders, About. Language cards show each language in its own name and in yours; Appearance has preview cards for Light, Dark and System, the colour picker and preset colours below it.

font.title: New typeface: Coolvetica
font.desc: The whole interface uses Coolvetica, including Turkish and Cyrillic letters. Japanese uses the system font.

installer.title: Smoother updates and installs
installer.desc: Setup no longer asks you to uninstall the old version first. It removes the previous Sophy Studio silently and installs the new one on top. Your history, settings, downloads and shortcuts are kept.

performance.title: Lighter on older PCs
performance.desc: Blur and glow effects were removed and animations use only light, GPU-friendly motion, so the app stays smooth on low-end computers.

fixes.title: Fixes
fixes.desc: Hover colours in light mode, missing icon backgrounds on several pages, leftover untranslated texts and an unnecessary online font request at start-up were fixed. The Studio Folder button was removed from the home page.

feedback.title: Feedback has its own page
feedback.desc: Send Feedback is now a full page in the sidebar instead of a pop-up: pick Bug, Idea or Other, write as much as you need, and see tips on what to include. The app version is attached automatically.

motion.title: Smooth animations
motion.desc: Pages, cards and settings fade in gently, buttons react when pressed, theme changes blend smoothly, and the History and Chats panels now slide in cleanly from the right.

sponsors.title: Sponsors before every big action
sponsors.desc: A short sponsor card now appears before downloads, sample exports, saving tags and showing analysis results. A bar fills up while it is shown and the button unlocks after a few seconds. Sponsors keep Sophy Studio free.

icons.title: New Suno icons
icons.desc: Suno Downloader and Suno Style Prompter have their own new icons, which follow the colour theme like every other icon. Home page cards now light up in the theme colour when you point at them.
